messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed weird behavior when saving a view scoped to a route that pins a model. Saved query shows up under route A but not when you switch to model tab. Is that intended? :thinking:
drew: Hmm that's not expected. Saved views should surface on both route and model contexts if scope includes model. Can you paste repro? :eyes:
maria: repro: create saved view on route /chat with scope=model+route, pin model `rwkv-13b`. When I go to Models > rwkv-13b the view isn't in the list. On route it's visible.
kevin: sounds like our index for saved-views is keyed by route_id and forgets model_refs in the cross-index. Likely a bug in the saveflow migration to per-scope ACL.
jessica: this is UX confounding — teams expect a saved view that references model & route to be discoverable wherever either context applies. We should decide canonical behavior: union-of-contexts vs explicit-scope-only.
sachin: union-of-contexts makes discovery easy but complicates quota & ownership rules (which scope gets charged, who can edit). If a saved view crosses teams, ACLs matter.
maria: +1 we need to clarify owner/charge semantics. Current telemetry ties cost attribution to route only.
drew: proposal: API includes an explicit field scope: ["route","model","org"], plus canonical_owner, charge_to (route_id or org_id). On listing, UI should show a context-aware filtered view: if the current page matches any scope, include it.
kevin: technical note: adding scope field is fine, but we should avoid denormalizing and duplicating the large query index. Instead add a secondary index on model_refs and route_refs, and a small precomputed visibility bitmap for quick lookups.
jessica: UI concern: when showing the view in a different context, we should show a small badge like "bound: route" or "cross-bound" and an affordance to 'view origin' so users know where it was created.
sachin: telemetry: record view_origin, resolved_scope, and charge_target in events. Also capture whether the view was surfaced via cross-context discovery or direct context listing. We'll need this to evaluate safety and churn.
maria: good. Also need to decide default scope when users click "Save" from the route page — should it default to route-only or smart-default to include model pins?
drew: leaning smart-default: include anything the user has pinned/filtered at save time, but show a confirm modal that explains charge_target and visibility. That keeps UX obvious.
kevin: backend caution: if default includes model and model belongs to different org (partner scenario), we must block or require explicit confirmation. That should be enforced server-side.
jessica: rollout plan: feature flag `perroute_crossscope_savedviews`. Start with internal orgs, then 10% external accounts, monitor telemetry for unexpected exposures.
sachin: telemetry card: sample events: `savedview.create` payload snippet we want in the schema:
```
{
  "id": "sv_123",
  "creator": "maria",
  "scopes": ["route","model"],
  "route_id": "route_42",
  "model_refs": ["rwkv-13b"],
  "charge_target": "route_42",
  "visibility": "org:team-7",
  "origin": "route_create_flow"
}
```
kevin: also add `visibility_flags` for computed deny-lists so the UI can cheaply filter without calling ACL service for every tile.
maria: what about saved query quotas? If a route has per-route saved-view quota (say 200), and a model is referenced by thousands of routes, we could end up with duplicated logical views from model side if we naively materialize. Need quota semantics spelled out.
drew: quota rule suggestion: quota is enforced at creation against charge_target only. Discovery doesn't create new quota entries. If a view is created and charge_target=org, it counts against org quota; if charge_target=route it counts against route quota.
jessica: agree. And show the charge_target prominently in save modal. UX test 1: show a warning if charge_target is a small-route that will blow quota.
sachin: logging: add an event `savedview.surface` with resolved_charge, matched_contexts, and result_source (index vs compute). We'll need to update dashboards to track surface-rate and cross-context bounce.
kevin: on the infra side, index update strategy: make the model_refs index eventually consistent; initial rollout can set `visibility_staleness` flag so UI degrades gracefully and shows a toast if a view might be missing from model list temporarily.
maria: sweet. Action items: 1) Drew: draft API contract for `savedview` with scope/charge fields. 2) Kevin: prototype secondary index + visibility bitmap. 3) Sachin: telemetry schema and dashboards. 4) Jessica: mockups for save modal, discoverability badges and warning copy. I'll coordinate canary groups.
drew: starting API draft in PR #4602, ping me for review.
kevin: i'll spike index prototype, will tag infra for storage cost estimate.
sachin: will add telemetry fields to the schema and a dashboard with a gating metric for exposures.
deploy-bot: canary flag `perroute_crossscope_savedviews` enabled for 10% of orgs at 2024-11-07T18:22:30Z :rocket:
maria: thanks all — let's sync next Tuesday for rollout gating. :calendar:
